Name: Birthday Reminder Mail
Author: Katlamos
Description:
A simple mod that sends the player a message in the mail, flavored as being from either a friend or family member to remind them of an NPCs whose birthday is happening that day. Included in the text are recommendations for Loved (and occasionally Liked) items for that NPC, indicated by their capitalization to make them stand out.

This is my first attempt at a mod, and the idea is based on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/64556811]Quirinea[/url]'s Birthday Mail. I've created an optional download for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/46021252]FlashShifter[/url]'s Stardew Valley Expanded NPCs as well, for those who want to be reminded of their birthdays as well.
